title: testjig advertises urn:ietf:params:jmap:sharing instead of RFC 9670's urn:ietf:params:jmap:principals
description: The testjig's Session advertises the non-existent capability urn:ietf:params:jmap:sharing for the mounted sharing backend (Principal, ShareNotification). RFC 9670 §1.5 defines urn:ietf:params:jmap:principals (and urn:ietf:params:jmap:principals:owner); jmap-sharing-types exports JMAP_PRINCIPALS_URI. A conforming client looking for principals finds no capability and no primaryAccounts entry, so it cannot use the jig's Principal methods. The bad URI appears at crate-jmap-testjig/src/session.rs:89 (ADVERTISED_CAPABILITIES), src/http.rs:1042 (the post_jmap_all_extension_get_methods_dispatch probe, which passes only because the dispatcher does not check using), and tests/spawn_smoke.rs:55. Second gap, same fix: RFC 9670 §1.5.1 says the principals value in accountCapabilities MUST contain currentUserPrincipalId (Id|null), but the jig gives every account capability {}. Found 2026-11-15 while mounting quotas (JMAP-1igi.4).
acceptance_criteria: ADVERTISED_CAPABILITIES lists urn:ietf:params:jmap:principals (via jmap_sharing_types::JMAP_PRINCIPALS_URI), not :sharing; the principals accountCapabilities value carries currentUserPrincipalId (null or the seeded Principal's id); decide whether to also advertise principals:owner (RFC 9670 §1.5.2) and say so; the probe test and spawn_smoke use the RFC URI; session.rs doc comments updated; CHANGELOG entry
